title: Coefficient-wise Wright log-convexity and log-concavity in the first parameter of the normalized incomplete beta function
statement: For $a,b,\alpha,\beta>0$ and $x\tsim(0,1)$, write the relevant generalized Turán expression as a power series whose coefficients are denoted by $\psi_k$. **Coefficient-wise first-parameter conjecture.** The coefficients $\psi_k$ are negative for all $a,\alpha,\beta>0$ and $x\tsim(0,1)$ when $0<b<1$, and positive when $b>1$. Consequently, $a\to x^{-a}(1-x)^{-b}I_x(a,b)$ is strictly coefficient-wise Wright log-convex on $(0,\infty)$ for $\alpha,\beta>0$, $x\tsim(0,1)$ and $0<b<1$, and strictly coefficient-wise Wright log-concave on $(0,\infty)$ for $\alpha,\beta>0$, $x\tsim(0,1)$ and $b>1$. This is presented as a substantial strengthening of the earlier parameter-log-concavity theorem; the supplied text gives no resolution.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1509.05120
